generations.prompt: Create an original Minecraft Civilization inventory food sprite, centered single shallow cream ceramic square bowl containing golden diced potatoes, orange carrot chunks and a few brown bread pieces. Transparent background, no shadow outside the bowl, no utensils, no text, no surrounding scene. Top/front three-quarter view. Designed for a 64x64 pixel export: thick readable bowl rim, 6-10 distinct large food clusters, controlled stepped silhouette and limited warm palette, no tiny speckles. Late nineteenth-century practical meal. Render a large clean pixel-art master with hard color clusters; food is golden cooked rather than charred. The item represents one vegetable skillet portion, not a cooking pan.

criteria.silhouette_scale: One shallow cream square bowl with large readable potato/carrot/bread clusters; whole silhouette fits the transparent master.
criteria.implementable_geometry: Raster item only; exporter will reduce with hard alpha and shared palette.
criteria.mechanics_clearance: No mechanism or moving parts; no floating utensils.
criteria.period_materials: Matte cream ceramic and cooked vegetables suit the practical kitchen family.
criteria.family_consistency: Warm prepared-food palette matches the inspected portioning concept; avoids mechanical ornament.
criteria.controls_readability: Distinct food item, no controls or illegible text.
criteria.gameplay_scope: One served portion; no tray, preparation tool, new ingredients or meter.

criteria.matches_direction: Native 64px export preserves cream rim and distinct three-ingredient clusters.
criteria.geometry_uvs: Alpha-safe raster exporter; 60px extent in 64px image, hard alpha. Native generated-item JSON.
criteria.material_consistency: 24 warm colors; cream bowl separates orange carrots and golden potato from bread. No surface noise added.
criteria.assembly_interfaces: Edible item, no assembly or ports; per-stack quality remains readable through tooltip.
criteria.animation_states: Fixed served sprite; dynamic food state belongs to stove renderer.
criteria.native_size_readability: Inspected actual native and 2x exports: clear bowl silhouette, recognizable large clusters and clean edge.

criteria.photon_materials: Prepared portion has a cream ceramic rim and warm orange/golden ingredient clusters in the actual inventory. Original item sprite remains distinct from pack bread/potato inputs.
criteria.scale_readability: Bowl silhouette and food clusters survive native inventory scaling; no extraneous utensil or decoration.
criteria.states_motion: Fixed portion appearance is intentional. Cooking color progression is visible in the stove; finished quality and saved calorie values travel in components/tooltips.
criteria.interaction_guides: Edible item displays quality, duration and benefit, with calorie tooltip supplied by the existing food inspector. Server consumption check grants the stored calories and nonstacking work benefit.
criteria.inventory_appearance: Actual Photon/Faithful inventory and stove-menu item views inspected beside the stove. Clean silhouette, restrained detail density and warm food contrast.
criteria.integration_limits: One recipe and fixed sprite. Sensory playtesting remains; full food-specialty family and moving-vessel handling are not claimed.
